rationale: The Latin anchor *considere* means "to settle/sit down (in a place)," pointing to a concrete sense of inhabiting or dwelling in a location, which aligns best with populate.v.01 ("inhabit or live in"). The other "dwell" senses are either abstract/metaphorical (dwell.v.02, dwell.v.04) or refer to mental rumination (brood.v.01, harp.v.01), none of which match the physical, locative sense of *a-sittan*.
